text: ok that did it so next use the $agent-seat skill and tap into the selected edges and realize that the set that has edge e971 can do a chamfer and the other grouping cant, but i cant figure out why that is
resolution: The chamfer asymmetry was traced to selection ownership/scope, not edge e971 itself: raw multi-edge selection readers could include stale edges from sibling Outliner parts, while the single-edge path already checked scope. The req_3904 repair adds owner-location surgery in the Outliner and makes all edge topology readers intersect with the active scope.
